_source: Hand-verified from ASX Appendix 5B (EQ Resources, quarter ended 31 December 2025, filed 21 January 2026). All values AUD, scale=thousands confirmed from column header '$A\'000'. Filing header confirms 'All financial numbers are quoted in Australian dollars unless otherwise stated'. Cash-flow values verified by direct PDF read; arithmetic cross-check: 11,474 + 1,154 + (-2,656) + 12,012 + (-5) = 21,979 (rounding: section 4.6 shows 21,978; section 5.5 bank balance shows 21,979; 1k is a filing rounding artifact). No income statement in 5B format.

notes._fixture_purpose: Second quarterly ticker fixture. EQR is an operating mining company (tungsten, Mt Carbine + Barruecopardo), contrasting with GRE (explorer-only). Both are AUD 5B format. Cash-flow values hand-verified.
notes._currency_confirmed: AUD confirmed from filing header. EQR has EUR-denominated Spanish loan facilities; 5B reporting is in AUD. FX movement of -5k ($A'000) reflects EUR translation.
notes.operating_cf: 5B section 1.9: +1,154 ($A'000). Group generates positive operating cash. Barruecopardo: +14.2M; Mt Carbine: -10.9M; corporate: -1.9M; interest -2,467; diesel credits +301; etc.
notes.investing_cf: 5B section 2.6: -2,656 ($A'000). Main items: PP&E/TOMRA sorter -2,331; exploration -23; ERC deposits -255; tenement proceeds +6; other +(-47 net).
notes.financing_cf: 5B section 3.10: +12,011 ($A'000). Equity raising +33,500; options exercised +683; transaction costs -2,326; debt repayment -18,183; lease repayments -1,663; royalty financing not applicable in quarter. Note: section 4.4 shows 12,012 due to 1k rounding vs section 3.10.
notes.cash_end: 5B section 5.5 bank balance: 21,979 ($A'000). Section 4.6 shows 21,978 (1k rounding artifact). Tolerance 0.001 covers both values. Cross-check: 11,474 + 1,154 - 2,656 + 12,012 - 5 = 21,979.
notes.capex: PP&E payments (2.1(c)) = 2,331 (mainly TOMRA ore sorter). Exploration (2.1(d)) = 23. Not asserted in metrics — capex convention (PP&E only vs exploration included) unresolved in pipeline.
notes.revenue: Not present in Appendix 5B format (accrual basis). Cash receipts from customers 21,836 is NOT accrual revenue. Expected null.
notes.ebit: Not present in Appendix 5B format. Expected null.
notes.np_attributable: Not present in Appendix 5B format. Expected null.
notes.net_debt: Total drawn debt (section 7): ~39,103 AUD'000. Balance sheet not in 5B. Pipeline B4 derivation (total_debt - cash_end) cannot fire without a balance sheet total_debt row. Expected null.
